step.prompt: /crew-research Verify three facts the Teamly team assumes, with sources: (1) the current stable FastAPI version and its Python requirement, (2) whether Postgres row-level security can enforce per-workspace isolation, (3) the free-tier limits of one managed Postgres provider of your choice. Write docs/02-research.md and finish. Do not ask questions.
step.judge: Read docs/02-research.md. Score 5 if each of the three questions has a finding with a source URL or a command, a checked-on date and a confidence label, contradictions are reported rather than resolved silently, and spikes are listed with a time box. Score 3 if sources are present but confidence or dates are missing. Score 1 if facts are asserted from memory.

judge.reason: docs/02-research.md gives each of the three questions (FastAPI version, Postgres RLS, Neon free tier) a findings table with a URL or exact command, a 2026-10-31 checked-on date and a verified/partially verified/unverified label; gaps and single-source facts are flagged explicitly (e.g. card requirement confirmed by only one page, session-setting RLS pattern marked unverified) rather than smoothed over, and the Spikes table lists four prototypes with 2–4 hour time boxes.
